title: Fail-closed registration guard for new Platform Configuration entries

phases.objective: Require every new runtime configuration candidate changed in an application surface to have metadata-only Config Catalog registration with schema, owner, bounded risk, scope binding, resolver, readback, and Shadow evidence, while rejecting secrets, policies, generated artifacts, and fixed contracts.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: repository-tool lifecycle candidate discovery followed by platform configuration entry guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A changed runtime setting without a registry entry fails closed; a complete metadata-only entry passes only while status remains shadow/staged and all mutation and secret flags remain false; policy and secret candidates are rejected from the general Config Catalog.
steps: Discover hardcoded configuration candidates with redacted previews and candidate classes.
Read the metadata-only Config Catalog entry registry and verify its safety flags and entry schema.
Map changed runtime settings to normalized config keys and require an exact registry entry.
Reject new secret candidates and specialized policy candidates from the general runtime setting registry.
Validate schema, owner, risk, scope, binding, resolver, readback, Shadow evidence, and status for every registered entry.
Publish the guard report as read-only CI evidence and fail the repository-tool lifecycle when findings exist.
assertions: The registry contract is mad4b.platform-configuration-entry-registry.v1 and contains metadata only, never configuration values or secrets.
Every registry entry has a normalized config key, schema reference, owner, bounded risk, scope types, binding reference, resolver reference, readback reference, and Shadow evidence reference.
New runtime settings changed in application surfaces fail with CONFIG_ENTRY_REGISTRATION_MISSING until registered.
Secret candidates fail with NEW_SECRET_CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE and policy candidates fail with NEW_POLICY_CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE.
Generated artifacts, docs, CI plumbing, migration sources, and maintenance tooling are not misclassified as runtime settings by this guard.
Only shadow or staged status is accepted; Production activation and runtime/database mutation remain disabled.
The guard is registered as a read_only maintenance tool and is executed by repository-tool lifecycle CI.
No repository mutation, database mutation, migration apply, provider call, credential read, or Production activation occurs during evaluation.
